name: Orange Scholars Scholarship Program
background: The Orange Scholars Program offers scholarships to associates and their children based on financial need and academic performance, as well as community involvement and leadership. Financial need is given the highest consideration.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors

name: KFC Foundation Scholarships
background: The KFC Foundation helps employees pursue their dreams of going to college by offering scholarships supporting KFC restaurant employees pursuing college or trade school degrees. GPA tiers may affect the amount awarded.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Out of the Box Competition
background: JSOM is excited to bring this opportunity to students and open the door to future opportunities within the field of Supply Chain Management. The topic each year will vary. Last year's prompt was about improving efficiency and customer experience for a clothing retailer.

name: Paul S. Mills Scholarship
background: The Paul S. Mills Scholarship program offers scholarships to students pursuing a degree in a financial service related field. This may include finance, accounting, insurance or risk management, actuarial sciences, and personal financial planning. To apply you must complete an application and write a short essay (500 words) describing why you wish to pursue an education in the financial service field and why the scholarship is important to you.

name: AFWA Undergraduate Scholarship
background: The purpose of the scholarship is to support the costs of attending 3rd, 4th, or 5th year when pursuing an accounting or finance degree. Scholarship awards are presented to students who have completed their sophomore year of college (or 60 semester hours or the equivalent) by the time of the application deadline and are majoring in accounting or finance.  Scholarship candidates will be reviewed on leadership, character, communication skills, scholastic average and financial need. The number of recipients and the maximum dollar amounts will vary.

name: Culver’s Foundation Scholarship
background: Since 1993, the Culver’s Foundation Scholarship has awarded over $8 million in scholarships to deserving employees based on their academic achievement and the differences they can make in their communities and careers.

name: GIVERSITY in STEM Scholarship
background: The GIVERSITY in STEM Scholarship aims to support high school seniors and undergraduate students pursuing a degree in a STEM-related field. A statement about your educational plans is required.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Surety Bond Authority Scholarship
background: The Surety Bond Authority scholarship program is open to all high school and college students who are currently enrolled in or who are in pursuit of a degree in Accounting, Banking, Finance, or other business-related coursework.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Hungry for Education Scholarship
background: Since 2011, Denny’s has been preparing students for the future through the Hungry for Education™ scholarship program. They have given away over $2.7 million in scholarships to support deserving students who are truly difference-makers in their communities.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors,  Graduate

name: Kroger Scholars Program
background: As an associate of Kroger, we value your commitment to hard work – for your family, our customers and the community we share. To thank you, The Kroger Co. Foundation is awarding scholarships to associates and their children who are students passionate about making a difference in the community.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Sttark You Can’t Label People, But You Can Label Products
background: The Sttark scholarship is a great opportunity for creative students who want to combine their writing and design talents to reflect on the impact of labels in our society. This scholarship encourages students to reflect on how labels impact creativity and perception while showcasing their artistic and writing skills.

name: NGA Foundation Scholarship
background: The NGA Foundation seeks to position the independent grocery industry as an employer of choice for college students and is committed to supporting students planning careers with this industry. Since 1990 NGA and its affiliates have awarded over $1 million in scholarships providing the critical resources needed to invest in our future leaders.
majors: Any Business,  Information Systems + CIS Tech

name: oxyGEN with AT&T National Scholarship
background: This scholarship recognizes student’s ability to demonstrate critical and creative thinking by effectively communicating the importance of a Science, Technology, Engineering, Art and Mathematics (STEAM) topic and their ability to make an impact in the field or community.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Shape the Future of Freight Scholarship
background: The Shape the Future of Freight Scholarship is  for students passionate about transforming the transportation, supply chain, and logistics industry. The scholarship encourages innovative thinking about how technology can create the most efficient freight brokerage possible. This is an exciting opportunity for students to share their creative vision and make a meaningful impact in the industry.

name: Garcia Family Scholarship
background: The Garcia Family Scholarship is intended for students attending a four year institution with a career focus on the marketing or distribution of floral products, including retail, wholesale, manufacturing and/or floral business ownership/operations.

name: National Society of Accountants Foundation Scholarship
background: The Foundation awards scholarships to undergraduate and graduate students enrolled in degree programs at accredited two & four-year colleges or universities. Scholarships are awarded based on scholastic achievement, demonstrated leadership ability, and financial need.

name: PMI GAC Scholarship
background: GAC scholarships are open to all students enrolled in GAC-accredited, academic, degree granting programs, in project/program/portfolio management or a project management related field of study. The purpose of the GAC scholarship is to support students who are studying project management, with the objective of using project/program/portfolio management to meet the current and anticipated needs of an organization.

name: PMI Dr. Harold Kerzner Scholarship
background: This is named in honor of Harold Kerzner, a globally recognized expert on project, program, and portfolio management, innovation and strategic planning, and Senior Executive Director at International Institute for Learning. This scholarship is meant to emphasize the strategic role of project management as a competitive advantage.

name: CVS Health Foundation Health Care Careers Scholarship
background: CVS has created a scholarship for college students pursuing healthcare careers (including business majors pursuing healthcare careers) funded by its CVS Health Foundation that supported nearly 100 students and awarded more than $1.2 million in pharmacy, nursing and retail management focused scholarships and supports in 2025 alone.
majors: Information Systems + CIS Tech,  Data Science

name: NACS Foundation Future Fund Scholarship
background: For more than 30 years, the NACS Foundation has provided scholarships to employees of their retail member companies and their children to fuel the next generation of industry leaders from within our member companies.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: KMF Foundation Professional Excellence Scholarship
background: The KMF Professional Excellence Scholarship Program offers up to $12,000 over two years to support driven college juniors and seniors pursuing careers in business, computer science, artificial intelligence, or data science.
majors: Any Business,  Data Science,  Computer Science

name: NRF Foundation Next Generation Scholarship
background: The 2026 NRF Foundation Next Generation Scholarship application consists of two phases. In the first phase, applicants will submit an essay, personal brand video, one letter of recommendation, resume, headshot and school transcripts. From there, ten students will advance and complete quick-fire video interviews with the NRF team. The top five finalists will then be selected and notified by October 6, 2026. The finalists will complete final round interviews with members of the NRF Foundation Board of Directors to determine the top recipient.

name: TELACU College Success Program
background: Because TELACU believes that the future leaders of our community must be engaged in meaningful careers that will change the face of our world, our TELACU Scholar cohort in large part consists of young people majoring in the fields of STEM and  Business. These fields of study are where our Scholars are able to most immediately find employment upon graduation and embark on long-lasting, high-impact careers.

name: Project STEM Heroes Scholarship
background: DoSomething + 3M are celebrating the premiere of Project Hail Mary by helping inspire younger students to build STEM skills for the good of our planet. Record a 60 second message to younger students sharing your passion and excitement for STEM, encouraging the nextgen to build their STEM skills for the future.

name: TLMI Academic & Vocational Scholarship
background: This scholarship is for students interested in a career in the tag, label, packaging, and printing industry. This scholarship supports students enrolled in programs that are relevant to the industry and encourages future leaders in areas such as management, sales, marketing, production, and graphic communications.

name: Ryan J. Gibbs Business Scholarship
background: The Ryan J. Gibbs Business Scholarship will be awarded annually to one student in their second, third or fourth year of undergraduate school. The scholarship requires an essay on a business-related topic that is changed to reflect current developments in business each awarding year.

name: Future Green Leaders Scholarship
background: The Future Green Leaders Scholarship supports students who are committed to creating a more sustainable world through business innovation, scientific research, or community-driven action. To apply, write an essay about why sustainability should be a priority in your field.

name: FSA Scholarship
background: HEB is encouraging any of its employees or their dependents to apply for the FSA Scholarship to help them pursue an education. This program was created in 1999 to recognize the potential of education in shaping the retail food industry.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: ULSCA Supply Chain Scholarship
org: University Logistics and Supply Chain Association
background: Founded in the mid-70s, ULSCA has flourished into a thriving community comprising members from over 30 esteemed Universities and Colleges. Our mission revolves around enhancing supply chain operations in higher education while nurturing the next generation of Supply Chain professionals.

name: Crystal Group Innovation Scholarship
background: The Innovation Scholarship, sponsored by Crystal Group, was founded in 2014 as a way to celebrate and encourage the spirit of innovation. At Crystal Group, we embrace innovation in all aspects of our business, including our rugged computing product line, our approach to sales, marketing, engineering, and our business culture.

name: Generation Google Scholarship
background: The Generation Google Scholarship supports aspiring students pursuing degrees in computer science, helping them excel in technology and become future leaders in the field. Selected students be awarded based on their commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, demonstrated leadership, and academic performance.
majors: Any Engineering/Technology,  Information Systems + CIS Tech
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Marketing/Public Relations Scholarship
background: The DigitalWise Media College Scholarship is designed to help PR students or prospective marketing students pay for their college tuition and further their education. This scholarship will go to deserving students who display a strong passion for their fields and is awarded twice a year.

name: Wikibuy eCommerce and Online Retail Scholarship
background: Applicants must submit a 500-word essay on the prompt found on the website highlighting their entrepreneurial and innovative spirit. Special consideration given to those seeking a career in online retail and eCommerce.

name: Rapid Formations Entrepreneur Scholarship
background: The Entrepreneur Scholarship Program is open to students to assist with the financial costs of studying, through which the acquisition and development of skills will potentially culminate in a successful enterprise. An essay about an entrepreneurial idea is required.

name: VMSD Scholarship + Experience
background: The PAVE Scholarship Program, now in its fifteenth year, provides financial assistance to students in educational programs preparing them for careers in the retail environments industry, including but not limited to careers in retail design, visual merchandising, interior design, architecture, product design, UX design, graphic design, and industrial design.

name: Pizza Hut Foundation Scholarship Program
background: The Pizza Hut Foundation is awarding students  who exhibit leadership in their communities. This is not an employee-exclusive scholarship and winners will receive a mentorship program as well as possible continued performance. Financial need will be considered.

name: 10X Digital Scholarship
background: 10x digital believes in nurturing and cultivating the current and future generations of digital marketers. Are you a high school senior or undergraduate who is looking to offset the cost of your business, tech, marketing or communications degree? Apply for the 10X digital marketing scholarship.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: NRF Foundation University Challenge
background: The NRF Foundation University Challenge isn’t an average business case competition. This unique experience gives undergraduate students the chance to apply what they’ve learned in the classroom in a real-world setting. A handful of teams will earn the chance to present their pitch to leaders from retail’s biggest companies. Students must be referred by their school's NRF advisor.

name: Triadex Services Scholarship Program
background: The Triadex Services Scholarship Program is an achievement-based scholarship awarded to graduating high school seniors and/or current college students each year. Students are recognized for their dedication to learning marketing and business methodologies, their capacity to lead and serve, and their commitment to making a significant impact on their schools and communities. Preference given to first-generation students but this is not required.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Stantec Future Leaders Scholarship
background: The Stantec Future Leaders Scholarship is designed to support the next generation of changemakers - students who are committed to making a difference in their industries and communities. Applicants should demonstrate leadership potential and show resilience and commitment to creating a positive impact in their industry or community.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: FSF Case Study Scholarship
background: The Fashion Scholarship Fund supports the careers of the country’s most promising fashion students from all backgrounds. It awards over $1.2 million each year to help students succeed in all sectors of the industry: design, merchandising, analytics, marketing and supply chain, among others. The annual FSF Case Study Scholarship is our signature program. No matter what sector of the industry you’re interested in, we have a challenge for you.

name: Remarkable Futures Scholarship
background: Chick-fil-A restaurant Team Members are eligible for two scholarships through the Chick-fil-A Remarkable Futures™ Scholarships initiative. Every year Team Members are encouraged to apply for scholarships through the Remarkable Futures Scholarship program. Over 14,000 recipients received scholarships in 2024. Leadership and involvement will be factored into consideration.

name: Inspired by Design: PAVE Student Visionary Award
background: This annual award honors rising student visionaries who demonstrate creativity and innovation in consumer environment design. Applicant must submit design work addressing human consumer-centered design themes.

name: NextGen Scholarship
background: The CPCU Society NextGen Scholarship Fund was created to promote higher educational opportunities for students interested in careers within the risk management and insurance industry.
majors: Any Business,  Information Systems + CIS Tech

name: Chick-fil-A Community Scholars Program
background: Through the Chick-fil-A™ Community Scholars program, Chick-fil-A, Inc. helps pay for the education of leaders in our communities who want to continue learning, while also investing in their leadership development. The Chick-fil-A Community Scholars will participate in a one-year engagement program that includes mentoring and leadership development opportunities.

name: Red Egg Marketing Scholarship
background: At Red Egg, we believe that higher education is a key part of a successful career. Unfortunately, the high costs of pursuing a degree often prevent many students from continuing their education. To help reduce the financial burden, we have created the Red Egg Marketing Scholarship, available to anyone pursuing a career in a creative or marketing-related field.

name: Global Student Competition
background: The PCMA Global Student Competition invites student teams from around the world to solve real-world challenges in the business events industry. Each year, participants develop creative, strategic proposals in response to a timely case study, then pitch their ideas to a panel of industry leaders. It’s a one-of-a-kind opportunity to showcase your talent, build your network, and make your mark on the future of events. Teams must have 3-5 undergraduate students.

name: NRF Foundation Bright Futures Scholarship
background: The NRF Foundation Student Program offers students the chance to explore exciting career paths in the retail industry and accelerate their careers. Students will have the opportunity to meet with and learn more about having a career at within the retail industry, including meeting with some of the most exciting brands in the country who are driving innovation.
awardRaw: NRF Student Program Trip to NYC

name: NRF Foundation Rising Stars Scholarship
background: The Rising Stars Scholarship was created to teach younger students about the variety of career opportunities available in the retail industry, and to encourage them to attend the NRF Foundation Student Program early in their academic careers. Each University Member can nominate one student for the Rising Stars Scholarship.
awardRaw: NRF Student Program Trip to NYC

name: NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship
background: The Ray Greenly Scholarship Fund awards students across the country who have the creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and forward-thinking to create new ways to connect retail customers to brands and products. Recipients are ambitious, curious, adaptable and have the potential to impact the future of digital retail.
awardRaw: NRF Student Program Trip to NYC
majors: Information Systems + CIS Tech,  Supply Chain Management

name: Modeling the Future Challenge
background: The Modeling the Future Challenge is a real-world competition for high school students combining math-modeling, data-analysis, and risk-management into one exciting challenge! To compete, students conduct their own research project modeling real-world data to analyze risks and make recommendations to companies, industry groups, governments, or organizations.

name: ParkON Scholarship
background: As a successful online business, ParkON recognizes that colleges and universities are hubs for new ideas and business innovation. Since 2018, we have proudly awarded private scholarships each year to two creative and driven college students who demonstrate exceptional potential based on a real world essay application of their studies. This year, applicants must provide input on the impact of parking on traveling consumer behavior.

name: Marketing Research Competition
background: Students in teams of 2-4 will have one semester to collect and analyze primary data (students determine the method) related to a national brand’s RFP. Student teams will produce a 20-slide presentation and submit it to the competition. Finally, the client and a panel of judges from the market research industry will identify the top three grad and undergrad teams.

name: Doc Cohen Franchising Scholarship
background: The Doc Cohen Franchising Scholarship will support the award of a scholarship and a travel stipend to attend the IFA Annual Convention. Scholarship candidates must be U.S. citizens enrolled in an accredited U.S. college or university, with a major or primary focus in one or more of these areas of study - business, finance, marketing, food service, hospitality, franchising, or entrepreneurship. Applicants must also submit a business plan up to 10 pages on a business concept with their scholarship application.

name: Fred DeLuca Foundation Scholarship
background: Created in memory of the co-founder of Subway, the IFA Foundation Scholarship Sponsored by The Frederick A. DeLuca Foundation recognizes and supports outstanding students interested in franchising who are enrolled in an accredited college/university with studies in business.

name: Future of Connectivity Essay Scholarship
background: Zipit Wireless is excited to announce the Future of Connectivity Scholarship, offering an award to a  student who envisions the impact of Internet-enabled devices on people's lives and industries. If you are a student passionate about the future of connectivity and have innovative ideas, we invite you to share your vision.
majors: Any Business,  Any Engineering/Technology,  Data Science,  Information Systems + CIS Tech

name: John Galt Scholarship for Future Supply Chain Leaders
background: This opportunity is designed to support passionate and financially deserving students who are committed to entering the supply chain profession. The John Galt Solutions Scholarship is open to passionate and dedicated students pursuing degrees in supply chain management, business forecasting, or related programs.

name: SBB Research Group STEM Scholarship
background: The SBB Research Group STEM Scholarship encourages and empowers students to create significant value and countless new opportunities for society through their pursuit of higher learning, especially through interdisciplinary combinations of Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM).

name: Forte College Scholarship
background: On a mission to inspire and invest in the next generation of business leaders, Forté is students' biggest champion as they earn their degree, start careers, and explore options like business school and career growth opportunities.

name: Allied Van Lines Scholarship
background: Allied Van Lines, one of the leading long distance and cross country moving companies in America, is excited to offer a 2026 scholarship program aimed at students whose area of study focuses on logistics and moving-related fields. We are committed to growing our industry and supporting the brightest students in logistics and moving.

name: Burger King Scholars Program
background: The Burger King Scholars Program is meant for employees and their families to be able to pursue their dreams in higher education. Participation in community service, extracurricular activities, or work will all be considered.

name: North American Van Lines Logistics Scholarship
background: North American Van Lines is proud to announce our first annual Logistics Scholarship contest. Three qualified entrants will each win a  scholarship towards their degree in logistics or supply chain management at the college or university of their choice.

name: Raftelis Leadership Scholarship
background: The Raftelis Leadership Scholarship is available to promising students with an interest in becoming problem solvers and becoming consultants. An interest in  local government is preferred.

name: RevPart STEM Scholarship
background: RevPart is proud to support the next generation of science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) students by providing a scholarship to a student demonstrating excellent promise in their area of study. As an innovator in the tech industry, we understand the importance of the STEM fields and wish to advocate for the industry's future leaders by assisting their efforts towards a degree.

name: 561 Build STEM Scholarship
background: South Florida Forensic Engineering offers one annual Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM) scholarship to students based on their scholastic achievement and essay describing their background, major, aspirations, and any additional relevant information.

name: MIT THINK Out of the Box Scholars Program
background: THINK caters to students who have done extensive research on the background of a potential research project, but lack the resources to complete the project themselves and are looking for additional guidance in the early stages of their project. The program is organized by a group of undergraduates at MIT. Applicants must propose a project with clear goals, an innovative idea, and a practical plan for implementation.

name: Taco Bell Live Más Scholarship
background: Taco Bell is all about fueling the doers, dreamers, and cultural rebels who know how to Live Más. Whether you’re just discovering what fires you up, chasing your passion every day, or turning it into something bigger, the Live Más Scholarship is here to help you level up. The scholarship is open to both employees and non-employees who can share how they're pursuing their passion. Awards are renewable.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Microsoft Imagine Cup
background: Imagine Cup is where student founders turn bold ideas into solutions trusted by organizations worldwide. At every step, you’ll have access to Microsoft’s AI technologies, tailored guidance, and connections that help you refine your product and grow as a founder.  Launch applicant teams with a creative idea get to leverage $5000 of Azure credits to build anything that solves a business problem.

name: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship
background: Amazon Future Engineer students can boost their future for themselves and their community with the support of college funding, paid internships, and industry mentors. Scholarship winners will receive a paid internship at Amazon after their freshman year.
majors: Any Business,  Any Engineering/Technology,  Data Science,  Mathematics/Statistics

name: NGA Foundation Student Case Study Competition
background:
Since it began in 2004, the NGAF Student Case Study Competition has strived to further the professional development of
collegiate students pursuing degrees in food and retail programs, expose students to the independent grocery industry, and
provide student teams the opportunity to creatively address real-world issues impacting the industry. The NGA Foundation student case study competition brings students from across the country to the NGA Show where they present solutions to an issue currently impacting the independent grocery industry.

name: Supply Chain Management Scholarship
org: R. Gene and Nancy D. Richter Foundation
background: The R. Gene and Nancy D. Richter Foundation and the R. Gene Richter Scholarship fund at ISM will provide a scholarship to individuals seeking education in supply management, supply chain management or procurement. Recipients of this award have earned outstanding grades. Transcripts are looked at very closely. Past winners have been involved and active participants in campus activities and are usually an officer in one of the organizations. Others have led charitable efforts within their communities.

name: Licensing International Scholarship Program
background: As part of our mission to inspire the next generation of talent globally while advancing the understanding of licensing in society, Licensing International’s Scholarship Program grants scholarships to deserving individuals around the world who are interested in a career in brand licensing and commerce.

name: MHEFI Scholarship
background: MHEFI offers scholarship award opportunities to undergraduate students who are pursuing a material handling, logistics or supply chain career. The student should clearly demonstrate dedication to achieving excellence, strong leadership skills, potential for future growth as a leader and persistence in the pursuit of education.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors

name: INKAS Rising Star Scholarship
background: The INKAS "Rising Star” is an annual award and scholarship program funded by the Khazanski Foundation in partnership with INKAS Armored Vehicle Manufacturing and awarded to post-secondary students showing excellence in both engineering and business fields of study. In addition to providing your personal story and an explanation as to why you deserve this scholarship, you are required to explain why you believe either business or engineering is important in Canada’s/U.S. economy and how you feel you will make a difference in your chosen industry.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: 1st Formations Business Scholarship
background: As part of our ongoing dedication to supporting new business, we are helping to fund the next generation of entrepreneurs. Our Scholarship provides additional funding for those who need it most, assisting budding entrepreneurs in accessing the education, skills and knowledge required to run their own business in the future. Applicants must submit a  business idea they would like to pursue
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Ritchie-Jennings Memorial Scholarship
background: The Ritchie-Jennings Memorial Scholarship offers students the opportunity to advance their education and anti-fraud career paths. Award amounts range from $2,000 to $10,000, and recipients also receive a full year of ACFE membership. The scholarship program, established in 1992, was renamed in honor of ACFE members Larry Jennings and Tracy Ritchie, who lost their lives in a terrorist attack in Karachi, Pakistan, in 1997.

name: Costco Employee Scholarship
background: All regular full- and part-time and limited part-time permanent Costco employees residing in the United States and Puerto Rico may be eligible for up to $10,000 in scholarship support to pursue a first-time degree. This is a renewable scholarship dependent on continued employment at a Costco retail location.
years: High School Admit,  Freshmen,  Sophomores,  Juniors,  Seniors

name: Draper Pitch Competition
background: Formerly known as the Big Idea Competition, the undergraduate division of the Draper Pitch Competition is UT Dallas’ flagship entrepreneurship event, bringing together students and alumni to pitch innovative startups and ideas to peers, investors, and an esteemed panel of judges. Powered by the generous support of the Draper Foundation, led by world-renowned venture capitalist Tim Draper, the competition now offers unprecedented opportunities for funding, mentorship, and exposure.

name: Bill Palmer Legacy Scholarship
background: Applebee’s International, Inc. has established a scholarship program to assist employees and children of employees who plan to continue their education in college. Academic performance and leadership will be considered.

name: Clarkston Scholars Program
background: A Clarkston Scholar is a highly-driven, first-generation college student who excels in the classroom, has an interest in consulting in the fields of consumer products, life sciences, or the retail industry.

name: Gucci Changemakers Scholarship
background: The Gucci Changemakers Scholarship Fund is dedicated to empowering students in creative and business-oriented fields through substantial financial support.

name: TLF Undergraduate Scholarship
background: The TLF Undergraduate Scholarships are open to students studying advertising, marketing, public relations, or a related field.  Undergraduate scholarship recipients will receive a trip where they will participate in career building activities, including a welcome dinner with a keynote speaker, three-day long career development & professional workshops and a scholarship & donor recognition reception in Cincinnati, OH.

name: SVCF Samsung Semiconductor Scholarship
background: The Samsung Semiconductor Scholarship program, inspired by the theme “Collaborate. Innovate. Grow.,” supports the next generation of STEM innovators shaping the future of technology. This program aims to recognize exceptional undergraduate and master’s students in STEM-related fields who embody innovation and diversity.

name: Opus Scholarship
background: Opus is an integrated group of commercial real estate development, construction and design companies with offices and projects across the country that has launched a scholarship to support students. Applicants will be judged on academic performance, financial need, involvement in organizations and activities on campus, community involvement and essay responses.
majors: Any Engineering/Technology,  Architecture,  Design,  Any Business,  Information Systems + CIS Tech

name: SILA Post Secondary College Scholarship
background: The purpose of the SILA Foundation is to provide an educational forum for the public. Educational content will cover Financial Services, specifically Securities and/or Insurance, and its purpose will be to develop and/or improve individuals’ capabilities regarding Financial Services. Activities may include educational materials, courses, public discussion groups, forums, panels, lectures, personal career development, mentoring, job training, job fairs, or other programs as determined by the SILA Foundation Board of Trustees.
majors: Any Business,  Information Systems + CIS Tech

name: Milton Cooper Trailblazer in Real Estate Award
background: Winners of the Milton Cooper Scholarship will receive an all-expenses-paid trip to ICSC LAS VEGAS, the premier event for commercial real estate professionals. Additionally, recipients will receive complimentary ICSC Student Membership, which provides exclusive access to networking opportunities and resources to propel their careers in this evolving field.

name: Continental Realty Scholarship
background: Applicants must have a demonstrated interest in the retail real estate industry, focusing on the development and management of marketplaces and spaces where people shop, dine, work, play, and gather.

name: Edison Charitable Foundation Scholarship
background: The Edison Charitable Foundation Scholarship is available to college students with a demonstrated interest in retail real estate. Special consideration is given to students from underrepresented groups.

name: Federal Realty Undergraduate Scholarship
background: The Edison Charitable Foundation Scholarship is available to college students with a demonstrated interest in retail real estate. This award is specifically renewable for sophomores or juniors who apply, but not seniors.

name: ICSC Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
background: The ICSC Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship is general scholarship available to undergraduate college students who are interested in retail real estate or any related fields.

name: Kite Realty Group Undergraduate Scholarship
background: The Kite Realty Group Undergraduate Scholarship honors the legacy of Savannah Lee, a talented young professional whose strong work ethic and dedication to her work made a lasting impact on the industry. This scholarship is dedicated to fostering an environment where all voices are valued and supports students who demonstrate leadership, academic achievement and a vision for an inclusive and thriving industry. Students from underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply, but this is not required.

name: PGIM Real Estate Scholarship
background: The PGIM Real Estate Scholarship, in Memory of Bernard Winograd supports college students who are interested in retail real estate or related fields. Winners will receive an internship in addition to their award.

name: Philips Edison & Company Scholarship
background: The Phillips Edison & Company Scholarship is available to US College students with any interest in the retail real estate industry. Special consideration will be given to students from underrepresented groups.

name: Schurgin Family Foundation Entrepreneurial Scholarship
background: The Schurgin Family Foundation Entrepreneurial Scholarship is available to students seeking a bachelor's degree in the retail real estate industry or related fields. Students who can demonstrate their entrepreneurial drive and spirit are welcome to apply.

name: RMA Foundation Scholarship
background: The Risk Management Association Foundation offers scholarships to students in an undergraduate program who are interested in working in the financial industry after graduation. Participation or leadership in school, community, or work-related activities is considered.

name: AICPA Foundation Scholarship for Future CPAs
background: The AICPA Foundation Scholarship for Future CPAs provides financial assistance to undergraduate or graduate degree students majoring in accounting and interested in pursuing a CPA license after graduation. Applicants must not have a CPA yet and must become an AICPA member (free of charge).

name: Purdue Digital Marketing Competition
org: Purdue University Northwest College of Business
background: Gather a team of 2-4 undergraduate students and register your team to produce a video summarizing your digital marketing strategy for a real client that will be judged by industry professionals.

name: David R. Parsley Scholarship Fund for Supply Chain Management
background: Created to encourage students to pursue foodservice supply chain management careers, the David R. Parsley Scholarship offers undergraduate students scholarships. An ideal candidates would be anyone with interest in the restaurant, foodservice and hospitality industry. Applicants must submit an essay about supply chain management.

name: ICSC Foundation Case Competition
background: Our University Partners are invited to participate in the ICSC Foundation Case Competition, a virtual challenge that takes place annually in November. Teams may be comprised of four undergraduate students from the same university. Each university may enter only one team. Students may be from any field of study, but a focus on real estate, finance, architecture, law and engineering is ideal. Students must discuss forming a team with JSOM faculty.

name: ICSC & UNC Retail Real Estate Case Competition
background: The ICSC Foundation has partnered with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill to host the ICSC & UNC Retail Real Estate Competition, which takes place every year at our premier event, ICSC LAS VEGAS. We invite our University Partners to each enter one team. Teams may be comprised of four undergraduate students from the same university. Students must discuss forming a team with JSOM faculty.
